summary: Contracts 1.1.0 landed in src/ks/contracts/ (CONTRACTS_VERSION 1.1.0, schemas regenerated with new c5.approval, c5.recover_args, c6.run_anchor). Every CON-02 checklist item plus X1, X2, X7, X8-F1 and PMO S5 (barrier.deadline may carry conn_id, never an agent; reconcile can have empty evidence and names nobody) is implemented with a test in tests/contracts/test_con02_checklist.py. Kabir's sign-off tests are in tests/contracts/test_signoff_kabir.py: test_count_chain, test_rt8h_keyring_swap_detected_by_anchor, test_fresh_keys_differ, test_epoch_monotonic, test_expiry_cap_and_admitted_expiry (RT4-ready), test_depth_6kb_denied, test_pk_dot_rejected, test_repro_forces_unanchored_and_refuses_rogue, test_rundir_perms_agent_eacces (actually runs: root drops to uid 60001). Golden hashes re-pinned on purpose; each change is explained in the README changelog, and the format vectors did not change. Breaking for callers: split_obj_id now returns a 3-tuple, t0_seq is renamed t0_seq_est, TickFrame needs epoch and view, and Record needs reexec_of. pytest: 310 passed (was 231), also green under PYTHONHASHSEED 0, 1 and 999.
